'''Chengshi''' is an NPC in the [[Bank of Life]], [[The Black Shores]]. She is a plant breeder at the [[Black Shores]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Chengsi)
:'''Chengsi:''' Hello, what brought you here? Did something happen to the biological tanks?
:{{DIcon}} What is a biological tank?
:'''Chengsi:''' You don't know that? Oh, you must be the new Bloom Bearer! I'm Chengsi, the plant breeder here at the Black Shores.
:'''Chengsi:''' In those tanks, we're cultivating a special plant called "Mambo grass." It's closely connected to the Tethys' Space Anchors.
:'''Chengsi:''' You've probably seen the four giant Anchors that help neutralize the [[Tacetite]]'s frequencies.
:'''Chengsi:''' If something goes wrong with the Anchors, the frequencies can become unstable.
:'''Chengsi:''' That's where the Mambo Grass comes in. It's super sensitive to even the slightest changes in frequencies and reacts by moving its leaves, almost like it's dancing.
:'''Chengsi:''' The tanks are set up to detect these movements and send alerts to the nearest engineers and KU-Roros.
:{{DIcon}} What if there are noises nearby...
:'''Chengsi:''' Don't worry. The tanks filter out any random disturbances, so the Mambo Grass won't react to just any noise.
:'''Chengsi:''' Wait, is that why you're lowering your voice?
:'''Chengsi:''' No need for that! You can speak at a normal volume.
{{Dialogue End}}
